versions.content: The aggregation of DcmDspTextTableMapping at DcmDspAlternativeDataType is only valid if the category of the CompuMethod of the DataType referenced by DcmDspAlternativeDataType.DcmApplicationDataType has category set to TEXTTABLE or SCALE_LINEAR_AND_TEXTTABLE.
